name: Can I replace my reverse osmosis filters myself, or should I hire a professional plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my reverse osmosis filters myself, or should I hire a professional plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many homeowners can replace standard RO pre-filters and post-filters themselves by following the manufacturer's instructions. However, replacing the RO membrane or troubleshooting system issues can be more complex. Hiring a professional plumber from CG Plumbing Solutions ensures the correct filters are used, components are properly sealed to prevent leaks, and the system is functioning at peak efficiency. This can be especially helpful in managing systems with specific requirements or if you're uncomfortable with the process, avoiding potential damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: While some filter changes are DIY-friendly, a professional plumber can ensure proper installation, prevent leaks, and troubleshoot complex issues.
